svg.title: AI Flywheel 3+1 ecosystem architecture
svg.desc: A sanitized four-layer view: a non-SSOT client gateway and distribution layer on the outside, the AI Flywheel governance and evolution engine as the decision source of truth, an optional external profile and equipment repository, and a mounted local Markdown knowledge base.
